fractions-add-tops-and-bottoms.text: Adds fractions without a common denominator, often adding tops and bottoms: 1/2 + 1/3 = 2/5.

fractions-bigger-denominator-bigger.text: Thinks a bigger denominator (or bigger numbers) makes a bigger fraction, e.g. 1/4 > 1/3.

fractions-common-denominator-to-multiply.text: Finds a common denominator before multiplying fractions, which is only needed to add or subtract.

fractions-flip-wrong-fraction.text: When dividing, flips the first fraction or both, instead of only the second one.

fractions-cancel-when-adding.text: Cross-cancels numbers when adding fractions, a shortcut that only works for multiplying.

probability-add-instead-of-multiply.text: Adds the chances of independent events that must both happen, instead of multiplying them.

probability-forget-overlap.text: Adds P(A) and P(B) for an OR question without taking away the overlap that was counted twice.

probability-gamblers-fallacy.text: Believes past results of a coin or die change the chance of the next independent result.

probability-no-replacement-same-total.text: Keeps the original counts after picking without putting back, instead of reducing them.

probability-miscounted-outcomes.text: Miscounts favourable or total outcomes (e.g. favourable over unfavourable), so P can even exceed 1.

algebra-move-without-sign-change.text: Moves a term across = without switching to the inverse operation, e.g. x + 5 = 12 gives x = 17.

algebra-wrong-order-two-step.text: Divides before subtracting in a two-step equation, undoing the steps in the wrong order.

algebra-partial-distribution.text: Multiplies only the first term inside a bracket, e.g. 2(x + 3) = 2x + 3.

algebra-drop-negative-coefficient.text: Ignores the minus sign on the number in front of x, e.g. -3x = 12 gives x = 4.

algebra-less-than-reversal.text: Writes '4 less than x' as 4 - x instead of x - 4.

geometry-triangle-angles-360.text: Uses the wrong angle total for a triangle, often 360 (the total around a point), not 180.

geometry-slant-height.text: Uses a slanted side as the height instead of the perpendicular height.

geometry-diameter-in-area.text: Uses the diameter instead of the radius in the circle area formula.

geometry-perimeter-area-mixup.text: Mixes up perimeter (the distance around a shape) with area (the space inside it).

geometry-complementary-supplementary-mix.text: Mixes up the 90 degree totals (complementary, right angle) with the 180 degree ones (supplementary, straight line).

decimals-compare-by-length.text: Thinks a decimal with more digits is bigger, e.g. 0.35 > 0.7 because 35 > 7.

decimals-not-aligning-points.text: Lines up the right-hand digits instead of the decimal points when adding or subtracting.

decimals-percent-move-one-place.text: Does not move the point exactly two places when turning a decimal into a percent, e.g. 0.35 to 3.5%.

decimals-change-uses-new-value.text: Divides a percentage change by the new value instead of the original value.

decimals-reverse-percent-subtract.text: Undoes a percentage rise by subtracting a percentage, instead of dividing by the multiplier.

decimals-up-then-down-same.text: Thinks going up by 10% and then down by 10% gets back to the original amount.
